chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Thal'abah, from Bureyd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
that he disliked drinking from silver, and from a silver-coated cup, and similarly that one anoints from a silver-coated container, and the comb is similar to that.
ai.seo_question: What is the Shia ruling on drinking from silver cups and using silver combs?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) disliked drinking from silver vessels and from cups coated with silver. This ruling of dislike (karahah) extends to other uses of silver, such as applying oil from a silver container and using silver combs.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Sa’alba, from Bureyd, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
having dislike the drink in the silver (cup), and in the silver-coated glass, and similar to that if he<sup>asws</sup> anoints (oil from) a silver-coated container, and the combs similar to that’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Tha’labah from Burayd who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
disliked drinking from silver and silver-coated utensils as well as silver coated containers of perfumes and combs.’”
